source.source_title: Identify your iPod model - Apple Support (IE)
source.verification_notes: This record's retained evidence is extracted from Apple's general 'Identify your iPod model' page, not an individual technical-specifications page. The archived HTML file is the shared source page. Only identification facts explicitly present in that page are supported; detailed technical specifications require separate model-specific sources.
notes: Primary evidence is Apple's official iPod identification page; it supports only the model-identification statements retained in the source section.

Do not treat this source as a complete technical specification sheet. Model-specific Apple technical-specification pages have been discovered for some models and remain to be archived and mapped individually.

Model-specific Apple technical-specification source preserved section-by-section from https://support.apple.com/en-ie/112495 (apple_remaining_extraction/technical_specs_html/ipod-nano-5th-generation-tech-specs.html); Fifth-generation iPod nano technical specifications. Typed normalized values were not inferred by this archival pass.

extraction.note: Official Apple iPod identification text retained. Explicit model numbers, introduction dates, capacity options and navigation interface extracted where present with source-section provenance. sections.heading: iPod nano (5th generation)
sections.source_text:
Navigation: Click Wheel
Capacity: 8 and 16 GB
Model number and date introduced: A1320: September 2009
You can distinguish the iPod nano (5th generation) from previous iPod nano models by:
Its taller screen when compared to iPod nano (4th generation)
Its polished anodised aluminium finish
The inclusion of a camera and microphone on the back of the device
The iPod nano (5th generation) comes in nine colours.

sections.heading: Size and weight
sections.source_text:
Height: 3.6 inches (90.7 mm)
Width: 1.5 inches (38.7 mm)

sections.heading: Accessibility
sections.source_text:
Spoken menus allow listeners to hear many of the names of menus, song titles, and artists without viewing the screen.
An alternative large font can make menus easier to read.
A high-resolution LCD display with adjustable contrast and backlight settings makes it easier to read in low light.
Captions in video are displayed when they are present using a legible, high-contrast white-on-black font.

sections.heading: Environmental requirements
sections.source_text:
Operating temperature: 32° to 95° F (0° to 35° C)
Nonoperating temperature: -4° to 113° F (-20° to 45° C)
Relative humidity: 5% to 95% noncondensing
Maximum operating altitude: 10,000 feet (3000 m)

sections.heading: Environmental Status Report
sections.source_text:
iPod nano embodies Apple’s continuing environmental progress. It is designed with the following features to reduce environmental impact:
Arsenic-free glass
BFR-free
Mercury-free
PVC-free
Highly recyclable

2.2-inch (diagonal) TFT display
240-by-376-pixel resolution at 204 pixels per inch

sections.source_text:

sections.heading: Languages
sections.source_text:
Arabic, Brazilian Portuguese, Cantonese (Traditional Chinese), Croatian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, English, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hebrew, Hungarian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Slovak, Spanish, Swedish, Thai, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, and UK English

iPod nano supports 20 VoiceOver languages:
Chinese (Cantonese), Chinese (Mandarin), Czech, Danish, Dutch, English (U.S.), Finnish, French, German, Greek, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, Swedish, and Turkish; other languages are available with the purchase of a supported third-party text-to-speech engine

sections.heading: Accessories
sections.source_text:
In-Ear Headphones with Remote and Mic
Engineered for extreme clarity and audio accuracy, these headphones let you hear musical details you’ve been missing.
USB Power Adapter
Use this ultracompact USB-based adapter to charge your iPhone or iPod whenever it’s not connected to a computer.
Earphones with Remote and Mic
These earbud headphones have convenient buttons that let you adjust volume and control music and video playback.
Universal Dock with Remote
Get easy access to a USB port for charging and syncing your iPod or for connecting to a TV or speakers.
